dashboard.title: Portfolio Tools
dashboard.subtitle: Browser-based utilities. Nothing uploads, nothing gets tracked.

screenshotAnnotator.name: Screenshot Annotator
screenshotAnnotator.description: Paste a screenshot, annotate it, redact secrets, then copy it out as a markdown-ready image. Nothing leaves your browser.

info.input: A screenshot you paste or drop in
info.process: Annotate, redact or add alt text
info.output: A copy-ready image or markdown link

fileConverter.name: File Converter
fileConverter.description: Convert images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG) and data files (JSON, CSV, TSV), all in your browser.

info.output: The converted file, ready to download

fileCompress.name: File Compress
fileCompress.description: Compress images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG) with quality control, or Gzip any file, all in your browser.

info.output: A smaller file with the size saved shown

speedTest.name: Speed Test
speedTest.description: Measure your real-time download, upload and latency. Continuous monitoring or one-shot max speed.

qrGenerator.name: QR Generator
qrGenerator.description: Create QR codes for links, text or Wi-Fi with custom colors, and export PNG or SVG, all in your browser.

info.input: A link, text or Wi-Fi details
info.process: Encode it into a QR code

qrReader.name: QR Reader
qrReader.description: Upload an image of a QR code and decode it instantly, all in your browser.

info.input: A photo or screenshot of a QR code
info.output: The URL or text it contains

wcagScanner.name: WCAG Scanner
wcagScanner.description: Crawl a whole site and audit every page for WCAG accessibility issues with axe-core.

info.output: A list of accessibility issues per page

counter.name: Counter
counter.description: Track people entering and exiting a venue with a simple manual tally. Saved on this device.

info.input: Taps as people enter or exit

jsonTools.name: JSON Tools
jsonTools.description: Format, validate and query JSON with a live JSONPath explorer. Pretty-print, minify or sort keys, all in your browser.

info.process: Format, validate or query it with JSONPath

jwtDecoder.name: JWT Decoder
jwtDecoder.description: Decode a JWT's header and payload, inspect standard claims and check expiry. The token never leaves your browser.

encoder.name: Encoder / Decoder
encoder.description: Convert text between Base64, Base64URL, URL encoding, HTML entities and hex, and swap direction with one click.

info.process: Encode or decode it (Base64, URL, hex…)

hashGenerator.name: Hash Generator
hashGenerator.description: Generate SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests from text or a file, in hex or Base64. WebCrypto computes them locally.

idGenerator.name: ID Generator
idGenerator.description: Bulk-generate UUIDv4, UUIDv7, ULID, Nano ID or short codes, with embedded timestamps decoded where available.

regexTester.name: Regex Tester
regexTester.description: Test regular expressions against sample text with live match highlighting, capture groups and a replace preview.

info.process: Match it live with your chosen flags

cronExplainer.name: Cron Explainer
cronExplainer.description: Turn a cron expression into a plain-language schedule and preview its next runs, in your local time zone.

info.output: A plain-language description and next run times

timestampConverter.name: Timestamp Converter
timestampConverter.description: Convert between Unix epoch, ISO 8601 and human-readable dates across time zones, with a live relative-time readout.

info.process: Convert between epoch, ISO and local time
info.output: All formats plus a live relative time

subnetCalculator.name: Subnet Calculator
subnetCalculator.description: Break down a CIDR block into network, broadcast and usable host ranges, check whether an address falls inside it, and split it into smaller subnets.

info.input: A CIDR block or IP address
info.process: Calculate network, broadcast and host ranges

passwordGenerator.name: Password Generator
passwordGenerator.description: Generate strong random passwords or memorable passphrases, with live entropy, strength and estimated crack-time.

info.process: Generate a random password or passphrase
info.output: A strong password with entropy and strength shown

passwordChecker.name: Password Checker
passwordChecker.description: Type a password and get an instant strength read: entropy, crack time and a pattern checklist. Nothing leaves your browser.

info.process: Score entropy and check common patterns
info.output: A strength rating and estimated crack time

schemeHints.base64: Standard Base64 (RFC 4648). Uses + and / with = padding.
schemeHints.base64url: URL-safe Base64. Uses - and _ instead of + and /, no padding.
schemeHints.url: Percent-encoding for URLs and query strings (encodeURIComponent).
schemeHints.html: Escapes characters like < > & " ' as HTML entities.
schemeHints.hex: Each byte as two hexadecimal digits.

hashGenerator.privacyNote: Hashing runs locally with the browser's WebCrypto API. Nothing gets uploaded.

hashGenerator.chooseFile: Choose a file or drop it here
hashGenerator.empty: Enter text or choose a file to see its hashes.
hashGenerator.sha1Note: SHA-1 is no longer collision-resistant. Prefer SHA-256 or stronger wherever security matters.

idGenerator.privacyNote: Every ID is generated locally with crypto.getRandomValues. Nothing gets sent anywhere.

kindHints.uuidv7: 128-bit UUID with a sortable millisecond timestamp prefix, good for database keys.
kindHints.ulid: 26-character Crockford base32 ID, sortable by creation time.
kindHints.nanoid: 21-character URL-safe ID with more entropy per character than a UUID.
kindHints.short: 8-character unambiguous code (no 0/O/1/I), good for support tickets and invite codes.
